Ref strength 250 mg/5 mL (also 125 mg/5 mL). Pediatric >1 y: 25-50 mg/kg/day in equally divided doses 7-14 d (2.2); severe 50-100 mg/kg/day; otitis media 75-100 mg/kg/day. Label does not fix the number of divided doses for pediatrics; adult regimens are q6h or q12h. Adult max 4 g/day. Patients >=15 y dosed as adults. Teva manufacturer label, eff 2020-12-31.

Ref strength 250 mg/5 mL (also 125 mg/5 mL). 6 mo-12 y: 7 mg/kg q12h or 14 mg/kg q24h, 5-10 d; total daily dose 14 mg/kg up to max 600 mg/day. Safety/efficacy not established <6 mo. Aurobindo manufacturer label.

Aurobindo azithromycin for oral suspension 100 mg/5 mL and 200 mg/5 mL (eff 2026-09-03); ref strength 200 mg/5 mL = 40 mg/mL. CAP >=6 mo: 10 mg/kg single dose day 1 then 5 mg/kg once daily days 2-5 (dose-change pattern); 5-day table tops out at 500 mg day 1 / 250 mg days 2-5 for >=50 kg. Safety/effectiveness not established <6 mo.

CLEOCIN PEDIATRIC (Pfizer) flavored granules, 75 mg per 5 mL reconstituted. Serious 8-12, severe 13-16, more severe 17-25 mg/kg/day in 3 or 4 equal doses; <=10 kg minimum 37.5 mg TID. Pediatric use statement covers birth to 16 y; no age floor stated. No labeled maximum.

Children: 6 mg/kg day 1 then 3 mg/kg once daily (dose-change pattern); up to 12 mg/kg/day by judgment. Reconstituted 1400 mg bottle = 40 mg/mL (10 mg/mL bottle also exists per label table). Efficacy shown 6 mo-13 y; not established <6 mo; premature neonates q72h. No absolute mg cap stated (equivalence 3 mg/kg~100 mg, 12 mg/kg~400 mg). Slate Run manufacturer label.

Adults and children: 150-200 mg/kg/day in equally divided doses every 3-4 h (IV first >=3 d). Neonates <=28 d have separate GA/PNA table (100-150 mg/kg/day q12h/q8h) so age_min set to 29 d. Respiratory/soft tissue <40 kg: 25-50 mg/kg/day q6-8h; GI/GU 50 mg/kg/day. Reconstitution ~100 mg/mL (IV admixture 2-30 mg/mL). Civica vial label (not pharmacy bulk).

Pediatric serious miscellaneous infections (non-meningitis) and skin: 50-75 mg/kg/day once daily or divided q12h, not to exceed 2 g/day; meningitis 100 mg/kg/day (max 4 g). IV reconstitution ~100 mg/mL; infuse at 10-40 mg/mL. Neonatal cautions (hyperbilirubinemia, calcium) so age_min 29 d. Sandoz manufacturer label.

Children: 6-7.5 mg/kg/day (2-2.5 mg/kg q8h). Infants/neonates 7.5 mg/kg/day (2.5 mg/kg q8h); neonates <=1 wk 5 mg/kg/day (2.5 mg/kg q12h) - excluded via age_min. 40 mg/mL adult vial (10 mg/mL pediatric vial also exists). Hospira manufacturer label, eff 2026-05-20.
Per-day expression of the same statement: Children 6-7.5 mg/kg/day in three doses q8h. Same label as the per-dose row (satisfies the both-bases requirement).

Children 2-12 y: 15 mg/kg q6h or 12.5 mg/kg q4h; max single dose 15 mg/kg (up to 750 mg); max 75 mg/kg/day (up to 3750 mg), min interval 4 h (Table 2). Infants 29 d-2 y: 15 mg/kg q6h max 60 mg/kg/day; neonates 12.5 mg/kg q6h max 50 mg/kg/day (Table 3) - separate bands not encoded. 10 mg/mL. Hikma manufacturer label, eff 2026-02-03.

Ibuprofen oral suspension 100 mg/5 mL (Aurobindo, eff 2026-03-30). Fever reduction, children 6 months up to 2 years: 5 mg/kg if baseline temp <102.5 F, 10 mg/kg if >=102.5 F; duration of effect 6-8 h; recommended maximum daily dose 40 mg/kg (no absolute mg cap). Analgesia same ages: 10 mg/kg q6-8h, max 40 mg/kg/day. JIA 30-40 mg/kg/day (not encoded). age_max follows the label's stated band.

Adults and pediatric >=6 mo (emetogenic chemotherapy): 0.15 mg/kg per dose for 3 doses, max 16 mg per dose, infused over 15 min. PONV 1 mo-12 y <=40 kg: 0.1 mg/kg single dose (not encoded). 2 mg/mL. Hospira manufacturer label, eff 2026-05-22.

Hikma dexamethasone oral solution 0.5 mg per 5 mL (0.1 mg/mL; Intensol 1 mg/mL also on label). Pediatric: range of initial doses 0.02-0.3 mg/kg/day in three or four divided doses (0.6-9 mg/m2/day). Label gives no croup-specific or per-dose figure; no age floor stated; no labeled mg maximum.

Prednisolone sodium phosphate oral solution 15 mg/5 mL (label: 1.67 mL = 5 mg base). Label cites NHLBI: 1-2 mg/kg/day in single or divided doses for asthma uncontrolled by ICS/LABA, burst 3-10 d; general initial pediatric range 0.14-2 mg/kg/day in 3-4 divided doses; initial dose range 5-60 mg/day (max_per_day 60 taken from that range). age_min 1 y is a study choice (label gives no asthma age floor) - record in DEVIATIONS.md. Amneal manufacturer label.

GERD with/without esophagitis, 1 y to <17 y: 0.5 mg/kg twice daily, max 40 mg twice daily (Table 2). 3 mo-<1 y: 0.5 mg/kg BID may increase to 1 mg/kg BID; birth-<3 mo: 0.5-1 mg/kg once daily (not encoded). 40 mg/5 mL = 8 mg/mL after preparation. NorthStar label for oral suspension. dose_basis changed from template mg/kg/day to mg/kg/dose because the label states per-dose figures.
